items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He come to one of the gigs, bow down on the floor. He’s beautiful. A very humorous guy. Nice guy too.

ctx.x: I remember he used to sit up, when I was in New York City, he’d sit up watching you all the time, you and . . .
Yeah, yeah. He come to one of the gigs, bow down on the floor. He’s beautiful. A very humorous guy. Nice guy too.
